position.headline: Close the house cleanly in 3 days — then the real prize is the post-close window.
position.summary: Momentum is rising for the first time since the June stall: 5 completions/30d vs ~1/month all spring, a 36-day abstinence streak, exercise restarting. But compounding share of throughput is 0.0 — every completion went to linear obligations. Aug 14 closing is the irreversible gate; everything runs through it for 72 hours. The deeper structural fact: the 3-year mission (AI/software mastery) has zero Outliner footprint, so growth work cannot get scheduled. The Aug 15–24 window after closing — streak intact, obligations mostly cleared — is the highest-leverage moment of the year, and history says it will be missed without an external commitment device.
